== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Vroshir are an antagonistic group characterized by their lack of unified goals or internal loyalty, often acting as individualistic entities such as The [[Mad King|the Mad King]]. Despite this lack of cohesion, they are united by their specific methodology: the liberation of worlds. When encountering a new [[Iteration]], they seize valuable resources and relocate large portions of the population to their own massive homeworlds, such as [[Amorenthus]] or [[Tal’gullour]]. This process serves to tether those worlds more firmly to [[Way|the Way]], though their actions often leave behind chaos or fragmented realities. Historically, the first generation of Vroshir served the [[Abidan]], but they eventually worked to dismantle the [[Eledari Pact]] and the [[Court]] of Seven. In contemporary conflicts, they act as a major threat to the [[Abidan]], utilizing advanced defenses like moon-sized guardian beasts, star-blocking shields, and Void-based portals to facilitate their retreats. While much of their capability remains a mystery, certain high-ranking members are projected to possess combat power comparable to a Judge. Their influence can be felt through the thinning of [[Way|the Way]] in certain sectors, and they are known to use unique energy systems or specialized war machines to conduct their incursions.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The Vroshir are a group that resisted the power responsible for rewinding the [[Iteration]]. Seeking to expand their network by adding new worlds, they launched an attack against the [[Abidan]]. During their operations, a Vroshir woman commanded an army of ghosts, and the group utilized a bullet infused with their entire collective will.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Vroshir are a group of [[Bandits|bandits]] who prioritize seeking bounties while minimizing their own personal risk. To defend their ships, they employ protective workings, barriers, and guardian beasts the size of moons. These raiders conduct frequent attacks that result in many deaths, utilizing fleets and war machines to carry out their warfare. Through these methods, the Vroshir have successfully regained their momentum.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Vroshir]] are [[Bandits|bandits]] who seek bounty with minimal risk.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Vroshir]] use war machines and fleets in their warfare.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Vroshir]] had regained their momentum.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Vroshir]] are a group that conducts raids and causes many deaths.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Vroshir began introducing chaos as they extended their reach to tighten a noose around the [[Abidan]], [[Cradle]], and [[Sector Eleven|Sector 11]]. During their campaign, they utilized a trap to ambush the [[spiders|Spiders]] and demonstrated the ability to tear open portals into the Void. While they are capable of reaching into [[Way|the Way]] with a bone-gauntleted hand, the group also acts to save human lives. Their presence continues to threaten [[Sector Eleven|Sector 11]], yet they possess the ability to sneak into [[Abidan]] territory. Ozriel expects that it will be decades before the Vroshir discover his absence.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Vroshir are a group driven by a desire to claim the contents of various worlds. Rumors circulated that they were specifically targeting the current location, having already looted or occupied a thousand worlds. While they cooperated with the [[Abidan]] to establish [[OTEP]], they remain steadfast enemies of Ozriel.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Vroshir]] are a group that people rumored were targeting the location.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Vroshir]] wants the contents of this world.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A thousand worlds have been looted or occupied by [[Vroshir]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
